p8_p9.interpretation: The original P8/P9 records are retained as invalid method-selection evidence; they do not rule out correctly indexed mode or Schur preconditioning.

p10.interpretation: The original run accepted no state because its gauge also failed, but its predicate did not enforce the recorded true linear residual. The repaired predicate fails closed on every declared gate.

corrected_p8.decision: Reject this step at the fixed budget. Correct indexing improves the old invalid 0.659 residual by about 22.7x, so the method class was not ruled out by the historical run, but this corrected block Jacobi result still misses tolerance.

corrected_p9.decision: Reject this step at the fixed budget. Correct indexing and factored solves improve the old invalid 1.766 residual by about 79.5x, but the Schur system remains ill-conditioned and the true residual misses tolerance.

repaired_p10.decision: Reject every trial. The direction misses both its declared linear tolerance and the nonlinear gauge tolerance; the attractive force-only number is not an accepted equilibrium.
